title: Day 5 · the tower's trader, and downtime
headline: He spends 62 GP 5 SP at the trader and summons an owl in downtime.

bullets.label: Bought
bullets.text: a Potion of Healing (50 GP), incense for Find Familiar (10 GP), 5 rations (2 GP 5 SP). Coins 85 GP 2 SP 5 CP → 22 GP 7 SP 5 CP.

bullets.label: Downtime
bullets.text: a Long Rest; Find Familiar as a Ritual (1 h 10 min, no check): an owl (Fey), kept out of fights.
